scope: Website-level research directs per-item review; it never grants blanket redistribution permission.

sources.name: Start Bootstrap
sources.reason: Fifteen exact repository snapshots reviewed separately. Author MIT source plus embedded Bootstrap CSS license retained. Unverified photography, fonts, logos and vendor binaries omitted; runnable editions use original MigBits artwork/controllers. Approval is limited to recorded files and modifications.

sources.name: 8B
sources.reason: Template code has MIT evidence; photos and fonts have separate licenses. Official GSAP standard-license endpoint redirects to a temporary offline page during this review. No redistribution of the complete animation dependency bundle is approved from the free label alone.

sources.name: Cruip
sources.reason: Current official terms prohibit hosting, reselling or redistributing templates and derivatives. Legacy free listings do not supersede item-specific evidence.

sources.name: Getastrothemes
sources.reason: Both free and premium theme terms prohibit redistribution, resale and repackaging, including modified themes.

sources.name: Astro theme directory
sources.reason: Directory contains paid and independently authored themes. Catalog availability and the directory software license do not license submissions. No screenshots or template source mirrored under the platform license.

sources.name: Velora UI
sources.reason: Official MIT grant verified at discovery; complete template dependency, derivative-component notices, assets and isolated-build scope need additional review before import.

sources.name: Website-Templates collection
sources.reason: Aggregates separately authored templates. Root MIT metadata is insufficient to establish rights for every included submission, image and dependency; use original creators' repositories.

sources.name: shadcn.io template directory
sources.reason: Official directory states templates are independently maintained and their own repository licenses apply. Directory listings do not authorize mirroring code or preview artwork.
